label: Query Manage System Catalog (Server RBAC role)
type: a Server RBAC role, one of the 56 in learn/security/roles.md. NOT a privilege: Server's concrete role catalogue has no separately enumerable privilege tier, and this token is a role name, not a privilege name. Do NOT confuse with the privilege:capella-advanced-access-* family, which is Capella's genuinely separate 28-member privilege catalogue, nor with capella-role:* (Capella's flat management-plane roles), rbac-role:role, or sgw:role.
note: Re-filed from privilege: to role: in round 12. roles.md documents this as one of 56 Server RBAC roles, with its own 'Role: <label> (<internal_name>)' table and prose that calls it a role outright. The privilege: id was minted from SQL++ GRANT/REVOKE and monitoring reference pages, which name the bare token without ever classifying it, and round 10 then ruled the reference pages' reading correct - see reconciliation.md round 12. Same inverted fold as query-system-catalog (it too had a rbac-role: variant folded into privilege:). Recurrence 3, all three occurrences on AWR / auto-update-statistics pages in both the server and cloud trees - the shared-source SQL++ reference content that carries Server role names into the Capella tree.
